description: Regulatory Signs on State Maintained Roads is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Infrastructure and Transport. The Road Signs data set is derived from Department for Infrastructure and Transport, Asset Management, Ancillary Assets dataset. This data set is for either roads Maintained by the State or Federal Government for controlling access to or providing information on a State or Federal Government Road. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Infrastructure and Transport. Its tags are control, roads, signs, stop. It offers 4 resource(s) in GEOJSON, HTML, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
